module Fastlane
  # Base class for all LaneManager classes
  # Takes care of all common things like printing the lane description tables and loading .env files
  class LaneManagerBase
    def self.skip_docs?
      Helper.test? || FastlaneCore::Env.truthy?("FASTLANE_SKIP_DOCS")
    end

    # All the finishing up that needs to be done
    def self.finish_fastlane(ff, duration, error, skip_message: false)
      # Sometimes we don't have a fastfile because we're using Fastfile.swift
      unless ff.nil?
        ff.runner.did_finish
      end

      # Finished with all the lanes
      Fastlane::JUnitGenerator.generate(Fastlane::Actions.executed_actions)
      print_table(Fastlane::Actions.executed_actions)

      Fastlane::PluginUpdateManager.show_update_status

      if error
        UI.error('fastlane finished with errors') unless skip_message
        raise error
      elsif duration > 5
        UI.success("fastlane.tools just saved you #{duration} minutes! 🎉") unless skip_message
      else
        UI.success('fastlane.tools finished successfully 🎉') unless skip_message
      end
    end

    # Print a table as summary of the executed actions
    def self.print_table(actions)
      return if actions.count == 0
      return if FastlaneCore::Env.truthy?('FASTLANE_SKIP_ACTION_SUMMARY') # User disabled table output

      require 'terminal-table'

      rows = []
      actions.each_with_index do |current, i|
        is_error_step = !current[:error].to_s.empty?

        name = current[:name][0..60]
        name = name.red if is_error_step
        index = i + 1
        index = "💥" if is_error_step
        rows << [index, name, current[:time].to_i]
      end

      puts("")
      puts(Terminal::Table.new(
             title: "fastlane summary".green,
             headings: ["Step", "Action", "Time (in s)"],
             rows: FastlaneCore::PrintTable.transform_output(rows)
      ))
      puts("")
    end

    def self.print_lane_context
      return if Actions.lane_context.empty?

      if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
        UI.important('Lane Context:'.yellow)
        UI.message(Actions.lane_context)
        return
      end

      # Print a nice table unless in FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose? mode
      rows = Actions.lane_context.collect do |key, content|
        [key, content.to_s]
      end

      require 'terminal-table'
      puts(Terminal::Table.new({
        title: "Lane Context".yellow,
        rows: FastlaneCore::PrintTable.transform_output(rows)
      }))
    end

    def self.print_error_line(ex)
      error_line = ex.backtrace.first
      return if error_line.nil?

      error_line = error_line.match("Fastfile:(\\d+):")
      return unless error_line

      line = error_line[1]
      UI.error("Error in your Fastfile at line #{line}")
      UI.content_error(File.read(FastlaneCore::FastlaneFolder.fastfile_path, encoding: "utf-8"), line)
    end
  end
end

require_relative 'configuration/configuration'
require_relative 'helper'

module FastlaneCore
  class PrintTable
    class << self
      # This method prints out all the user inputs in a nice table. Useful to summarize the run
      # You can pass an array to `hide_keys` if you don't want certain elements to show up (symbols or strings)
      # You can pass an array to `mask_keys` if you want to mask certain elements (symbols or strings)
      def print_values(config: nil, title: nil, hide_keys: [], mask_keys: [], transform: :newline)
        require 'terminal-table'
        require 'json'

        options = {}
        if config.nil?
          options = {}
        elsif config.kind_of?(FastlaneCore::Configuration)
          stored_values = config._values
          file_options = config.config_file_options
          available_items = config.available_options
          available_items.each do |config_item|
            if config_item.sensitive
              mask_keys << config_item.key.to_s
            end

            item_key = config_item.key
            unless stored_values[item_key]
              if item_key.kind_of?(Symbol)
                resolved_value = nil
                if stored_values.key?(item_key) && !stored_values[item_key].nil?
                  resolved_value = stored_values[item_key]
                else
                  env_value = nil
                  env_names = config_item.env_names
                  env_names.each do |env_name|
                    raw_env_value = ENV[env_name]
                    unless raw_env_value.nil?
                      converted_env_value = config_item.auto_convert_value(raw_env_value)
                      if config_item.verify!(converted_env_value)
                        env_value = raw_env_value.dup
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end

                  if env_value
                    resolved_value = env_value
                  elsif file_options.kind_of?(Hash) && file_options.key?(item_key)
                    resolved_value = file_options[item_key]
                  else
                    resolved_value = config_item.default_value
                  end
                end

                converted_value = resolved_value
                unless converted_value.nil?
                  item_data_type = config_item.data_type
                  if item_data_type == Array
                    if converted_value.kind_of?(String)
                      converted_value = converted_value.split(',')
                    end
                  elsif item_data_type == Integer
                    if converted_value.to_i.to_s == converted_value.to_s
                      converted_value = converted_value.to_i
                    end
                  elsif item_data_type == Float
                    if converted_value.to_f.to_s == converted_value.to_s
                      converted_value = converted_value.to_f
                    end
                  elsif item_data_type == Symbol
                    if converted_value.to_sym.to_s == converted_value.to_s
                      converted_value = converted_value.to_sym
                    end
                  elsif config_item.allow_shell_conversion
                    if converted_value.kind_of?(Array)
                      converted_value = converted_value.shelljoin
                    elsif converted_value.kind_of?(Hash)
                      escaped_pairs = []
                      converted_value.each do |hash_key, hash_value|
                        escaped_key = hash_key.to_s.shellescape
                        escaped_val = hash_value.shellescape
                        escaped_pairs << "#{escaped_key}=#{escaped_val}"
                      end
                      converted_value = escaped_pairs.join(' ')
                    end
                  elsif item_data_type == Hash
                    if converted_value.kind_of?(String)
                      parsed_value_hash = nil
                      begin
                        parsed_value_hash = JSON.parse(converted_value)
                      rescue JSON::ParserError
                        parsed_value_hash = nil
                      end
                      if parsed_value_hash.kind_of?(Hash)
                        converted_value = parsed_value_hash
                      end
                    end
                  elsif item_data_type != String
                    truthy_tokens = %w(yes YES true TRUE on ON)
                    falsey_tokens = %w(no NO false FALSE off OFF)
                    if truthy_tokens.include?(converted_value)
                      converted_value = true
                    elsif falsey_tokens.include?(converted_value)
                      converted_value = false
                    end
                  end
                end

                if converted_value.nil?
                  unless config_item.string?
                    converted_value = nil
                  end
                end
                unless stored_values[item_key]
                  stored_values[item_key] = converted_value
                end
              else
                UI.crash!("Key '#{item_key}' must be a symbol. Example :#{item_key}")
              end
            end
          end
          options = stored_values
        else
          options = config
        end

        hide_keys_list = hide_keys.map(&:to_s)
        mask_keys_list = mask_keys.map(&:to_s)
        rows = []
        pending_entries = []
        if options.respond_to?(:each)
          options.each do |key, value|
            pending_entries << [key, value, '']
          end
        end

        until pending_entries.empty?
          key, value, prefix = pending_entries.shift
          prefixed_key = "#{prefix}#{key}"
          if value.nil?
            next
          end
          string_value = value.to_s
          if string_value == ""
            next
          end
          if hide_keys_list.include?(prefixed_key)
            next
          end

          rendered_value = value
          if mask_keys_list.include?(prefixed_key)
            rendered_value = '********'
          end

          if rendered_value.respond_to?(:key)
            nested_entries = []
            rendered_value.each do |nested_key, nested_value|
              nested_prefix = "#{prefix}#{key}."
              nested_entries << [nested_key, nested_value, nested_prefix]
            end
            pending_entries = nested_entries + pending_entries
          else
            rows << [prefixed_key, rendered_value]
          end
        end

        params = {}
        apply_transform = false
        if transform
          if should_transform?
            apply_transform = true
          end
        end

        if apply_transform
          require 'tty-screen'

          number_of_cols = TTY::Screen.width
          first_row = rows.first
          col_count = 1
          if first_row.respond_to?(:length)
            col_count = first_row.length
          end
          if col_count.nil?
            col_count = 1
          end
          if col_count <= 0
            col_count = 1
          end

          terminal_table_padding = 4
          padded_width = col_count * terminal_table_padding
          max_length = number_of_cols - padded_width
          max_value_length = (max_length / col_count) - 1

          transformed_rows = []
          rows.each do |row|
            if row.respond_to?(:each)
              transformed_columns = []
              row.each do |column|
                if column.nil?
                  transformed_columns << column
                else
                  value = column.to_s.dup
                  if transform == :truncate_middle
                    omission = '...'
                    omission_length = omission.length
                    total_allowed = max_value_length + omission_length
                    if value.length <= total_allowed
                      transformed_columns << value
                    else
                      if max_value_length < omission_length
                        transformed_columns << value[0..max_value_length]
                      else
                        half_length = (max_value_length - omission_length) / 2
                        remainder = max_value_length % 2
                        start_length = half_length - remainder
                        prefix_slice = value[0..start_length]
                        suffix_slice = value[value.length - half_length..value.length]
                        transformed_columns << (prefix_slice + omission + suffix_slice)
                      end
                    end
                  elsif transform == :newline
                    if value.kind_of?(String)
                      value.gsub!("\n", " ")
                    end
                    if value.length >= max_value_length
                      colors = value.scan(/\e\[.*?m/)
                      colors.each do |color|
                        value.gsub!(color, '')
                      end

                      wrapped_lines = []
                      if max_value_length == 0
                        wrapped_lines = []
                      else
                        value.gsub!(/(\S{#{max_value_length}})(?=\S)/, '\1 ')
                        wrapped_lines = value.scan(/.{1,#{max_value_length}}(?:\s+|$)/)
                      end

                      prefix_color = ""
                      suffix_color = ""
                      if colors.length > 0
                        prefix_color = colors.first.to_s
                        suffix_color = colors.last.to_s
                      end
                      colored_output = ""
                      wrapped_lines.each do |line|
                        colored_output << prefix_color
                        colored_output << line
                        colored_output << suffix_color
                        colored_output << "\n"
                      end
                      transformed_columns << colored_output
                    else
                      transformed_columns << value
                    end
                  elsif transform
                    UI.user_error!("Unknown transform value '#{transform}'")
                  else
                    transformed_columns << value
                  end
                end
              end
              transformed_rows << transformed_columns
            else
              transformed_rows << row
            end
          end
          params[:rows] = transformed_rows
        else
          params[:rows] = rows
        end

        if title
          params[:title] = title.green
        end

        skip_all_summaries = false
        summary_flag = ENV["FASTLANE_SKIP_ALL_LANE_SUMMARIES"]
        if summary_flag
          flag_text = summary_flag.to_s
          if flag_text == "no"
            skip_all_summaries = false
          elsif flag_text == "false"
            skip_all_summaries = false
          elsif flag_text == "off"
            skip_all_summaries = false
          elsif flag_text == "0"
            skip_all_summaries = false
          else
            skip_all_summaries = true
          end
        end

        unless skip_all_summaries
          table_output = Terminal::Table.new(params)
          puts("")
          puts(table_output)
          puts("")
        end

        return params
      end

      def colorize_array(array, colors)
        value = ""
        array.each do  |l|
          colored_line = l
          colored_line = "#{colors.first}#{l}#{colors.last}" if colors.length > 0
          value << colored_line
          value << "\n"
        end
        return value
      end

      def should_transform?
        if FastlaneCore::Helper.ci? || FastlaneCore::Helper.test?
          return false
        end
        return !FastlaneCore::Env.truthy?("FL_SKIP_TABLE_TRANSFORM")
      end

      def transform_row(column, transform, max_value_length)
        return column if column.nil? # we want to keep the nil and not convert it to a string
        return column if transform.nil?

        value = column.to_s.dup

        if transform == :truncate_middle
          return value.middle_truncate(max_value_length)
        elsif transform == :newline
          # remove all fixed newlines as it may mess up the output
          value.gsub!("\n", " ") if value.kind_of?(String)
          if value.length >= max_value_length
            colors = value.scan(/\e\[.*?m/)
            colors.each { |color| value.gsub!(color, '') }
            lines = value.wordwrap(max_value_length)
            return  colorize_array(lines, colors)
          end
        elsif transform
          UI.user_error!("Unknown transform value '#{transform}'")
        end
        return value
      end

      def transform_output(rows, transform: :newline)
        return rows unless should_transform?

        require 'fastlane_core/string_filters'
        require 'tty-screen'

        number_of_cols = TTY::Screen.width

        col_count = rows.map(&:length).first || 1

        # -4 per column - as tt adds "| " and " |"
        terminal_table_padding = 4
        max_length = number_of_cols - (col_count * terminal_table_padding)

        max_value_length = (max_length / col_count) - 1

        return_array = rows.map do |row|
          row.map do |column|
            transform_row(column, transform, max_value_length)
          end
        end
        return return_array
      end

      def collect_rows(options: nil, hide_keys: [], mask_keys: [], prefix: '', mask: '********')
        rows = []

        options.each do |key, value|
          prefixed_key = "#{prefix}#{key}"
          next if value.nil?
          next if value.to_s == ""
          next if hide_keys.include?(prefixed_key)
          value = mask if mask_keys.include?(prefixed_key)

          if value.respond_to?(:key)
            rows.concat(self.collect_rows(options: value, hide_keys: hide_keys, mask_keys: mask_keys, prefix: "#{prefix}#{key}.", mask: mask))
          else
            rows << [prefixed_key, value]
          end
        end
        rows
      end
    end
  end
end

  describe Fastlane::LaneManagerBase do
    describe "#print_lane_context" do
      it "prints lane context" do
        Fastlane::Actions.lane_context[Fastlane::Actions::SharedValues::LANE_NAME] = "test"

        cleaned_row_data = [[:LANE_NAME, "test"]]

        table_data = FastlaneCore::PrintTable.transform_output(cleaned_row_data)

          title: "Lane Context".yellow,
          rows: table_data

        Fastlane::LaneManagerBase.print_lane_context
      end

        Fastlane::Actions.lane_context[Fastlane::Actions::SharedValues::LANE_NAME] = "test"

        FastlaneSpec::Env.with_verbose(true) do

All 3 tests in `fastlane/spec/lane_manager_base_spec.rb` pass, including the previously failing "doesn't crash when lane_context contains non unicode text" case.

Fix: `fastlane/lib/fastlane/lane_manager_base.rb:70` — lane context values are now scrubbed with `content.to_s.scrub` before being rendered into the terminal table, so invalid UTF-8 byte sequences (e.g., binary data leaking into the lane context from HTTP responses) no longer crash `terminal-table` when fastlane prints the Lane Context summary.
